item.title: Advanced Chemical Handling with Fluoroplastic-Lined Magnetic Drive Pumps
item.description:
Engineered Solutions for Corrosive Chemical Transfer
#

Lined pumps are designed with external metallic armor and an internal lining of advanced fluorinated engineering plastics. This construction enables the safe and efficient handling of highly aggressive and corrosive chemicals across various industries. The magnetic drive, seal-less design ensures leak-free operation and minimizes maintenance requirements.
